facts.business: Diligent Media Corporation Limited operates in the media sector, publishing DNA India newspaper and digital media platforms.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to inter-corporate deposits (ICDs) granted to Veena Investments Private Limited (VIPL) of Rs 17,340.27 lakhs outstanding as at 31 March 2026, and related NCRPS redemption arbitration; auditor unable to determine if adjustment required to carrying amounts per Ind AS 109.

key_risks: Uncertainty over recovery of ICDs granted to VIPL (Rs 17,340.27 lakhs)
Arbitration and legal proceedings regarding NCRPS redemption and ICD set-off
Non-accrual of interest from 1 January 2025 and no impairment assessment per Ind AS 109
Scheme of reduction and cancellation of NCRPS capital pending regulatory approvals
facts.related_party_note: ICDs granted to Veena Investments Private Limited (VIPL), which simultaneously holds 6% Non-cumulative, Non-convertible, Redeemable, Preference Shares (NCRPS) of the Company aggregating Rs 43,626.56 lakhs. Arbitration proceedings and proposed set-off of ICDs against NCRPS redemption.
